verdict.rationale: Honcho's own docs say the core is open source and can be self-hosted, so users can keep their data on their own infrastructure. The `honcho start` command runs the full stack, including Postgres, via Docker, which lets users decide where data physically lives. There is no evidence of region or residency selection in the managed Honcho cloud service. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for the hosted service, documented data-residency guarantees or compliance statements, independent corroboration of self-hosted residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: you can run the whole thing yourself and keep your data on your own infrastructure
honcho start runs API, deriver, Postgres, and Redis via Docker.
